Architecture And Design Services Agreement 
 This Architecture and Design Services Agreement (the “ Agreement ”) is made on [ ● ] , 202 1 (“ Effective Date ”) by and between: 
 Zameen Developments (Private) Limited hav ing its registered office at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M. M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore which expression shall, wherever the context so requires or permits, include successors, and assigns (hereinafter referred to as the “ Consultant ”) 
 AND 
 [ ● ] , son of [ ● ] , and holder of CNIC No. [ ● ] wherever the context so requires or permits, include his heirs, executors, administrators, successors, and assigns (hereinafter referred to as the “ Client ”) 
 
 OR 
 
 [ ● ] having its registered office at [ ● ] through its authorized representative [ ● ] holding CNIC No. [ ● ] which expression shall, wherever the context so requires or permits, include successors, and assigns (hereinafter referred to as the “ Client ”) 
 
 ( The Consultant and the Client shall also individually be referred to as a “ Party ” and, collectively, as the “ Parties ”). 
 
 Whereas: 
 The Consultant is engaged in the business of providing architectural design , planning, engineering and project management services; and 
 
 The C lient is desirous of availing the services of the Consultant for the purpose of designing a residential apartment building named and styled as “[ ● ]” (the “ Project ”) located at [ ● ] (the “ Site ”) as per the terms and conditions of this Agreement. 
 
 Now Therefore, in consideration of the foregoing understandings and the mutual covenants hereinafter set forth, the Parties agree as follows: 
 Term and Scope 
 
 The Agreement shall be effective from the Effective Date until such time the Parties have fully discharged their obligations hereunder (“ Term ”) . 
 
 The Client has agreed to avail from the Consultant and the Consultant has agreed to provide to the Client the Services ( defined below ) and to perform and carry out all such ancillary acts and tasks as required and necessary thereto. 
 
 Services 
 
 During the Term, the Consultant shall provide to the Client architectural services with respect to the Project, including inter alia planning, design and civil, electrical, mechanical and structural engineering design, as more fully described in detail in Annexure A of the Agreement (the “ Services ”) . For the avoidance of doubt, the Services do not include project management services or procurement of building and construction approvals. 
 
 In addition to the Services, t he Consultant shall: 
 
 Assist and facilitate the Client in preparing the drawings and related documents for the submission to relevant authorities for obtaining permits and approvals for the planning and construction of the Project; 
 
 Make up to [ ● ] revisions or amendments to the drawings/ design in accordance with any direction or instruction of the relevant authority or to cure any defect or deficiency identified therein; and 
 
 Upon request of the Client, provide any information or clarification that may be required for the construction of the Project. 
 
 Upon completion of each deliverable , the Client shall accept and acknowledge the completion of the said deliverable , in writing , within seven (7) days of delivery of the drawings by the Consultant . The Client’s failure to notify the Consultant within the stipulated time shall be deemed as acceptance of the deliverable by the Client. 
 
 Service Fee 
 
 As consideration for the provision of Services, the Client shall be liable to pay to Consultant and the Consultant shall be entitled to a s erv i ce fee amounting to Rs. [ ● ] ( Rupees [in words ● ] ) ( inclusive of all tax) ( “ Service Fee ” ) . 
 
 The Service Fee shall be paid in installments, includ ing a mobilization advance of [ ● ]% to be paid at the time of signing of this Agreement. The re maining ninety percent [ ● ] % of the Service Fee will be paid in accordance with the payment schedule in Annexure B of the Agreement . 
 
 T he Service Fee does not include out of city travel and accommodation costs associated with Site visits or any charges or fees for any approvals, permissions and authorizations , which shall be payable by the Client at actual and in addition to the Service Fee . 
 
 Upon completion of each deliverable specified in Annexure B, the Consultant shall issue an invoice. The Client shall pay the Consultant within ten ( 10 ) working days of the date of the invoice through bank instrument, deposit or transfer in favour of the following bank account: 
 Account Title: 
 Account no: 
 Branch: 
 Bank: 
 
 In the event the Client fails to make full and final payment against an y invoice within the time stipulated above , the Consultant may suspend Services until such time the outstanding payments are made by the Client in clear funds . The Consultant shall not be liable for any losses incurred by the Client due to such suspension of Services. 
 
 The Services Fee or any party thereof as paid from time to time is non-refundable and/or non-transferable . 
 
 All payments made by the Client to the Consultant shall be subject to deduction of applicable taxes in accordance with the law. 
 
 In the event that the Client enters into an agreement with Zameen Media (Private) Limited for the marketing and promotion of the Project, the Client shall be granted a discount, under this Agreement, of up to [ ● ] % of the Service Fee. 
 
 Client’s Obligation s 
 
 In order to enable the Consultant to commence the Services under this Agreement, t he Client shall: 
 
 provide full information regarding the Client’s objectives, schedule, construction budget, constraints and criteria, space requirements, flexibility, expandability and/or Site requirements for the Project along with any other information that may be required by the Consultant to perform the Services ; 
 
 p rovide copies of all surveys, investigations, soil tests, studies, reports or specifications with respect to the Project Site , including but not limited to topographical survey of the S ite, geotechnical investigations, sub-surface explorations, layout of any existing, proposed and/or recommended sanitary sewers, water lines, storm sewers, all other underground obstructions, street improvements, site drainage and detention studies, as appropriate, any and/or all of which might affect the construction o r design of the P roject; 
 
 p rovide information in the Client’s possession, or which is reasonably obtainable, and which the Consultant reasonably advises is necessary for the proper and timely performance of the Services, and the Consultant shall be entitled to rely on such information; 
 
 p rovide free and unrestricted access to the Site for inspections and visits as and when necessary; an d 
 
 p rovide all information and/or approvals in writing as necessary or required by the Consultant from time to time for the proper and timely performance of the Services . 
 
 The Client understands and acknowledges that the commencement of Services shall be subject to the fulfillment of the Client o bligations under Clause 4.1 above and the Consultant shall not be responsible for any delay caused due to the Clien t’s failure to fulfill its obligations thereunder . 
 
 Representations &amp; Warranties 
 
 The Parties represent and warrant that the Parties : 
 
 are validly existing companies and carrying on their business es under the Laws of Pakistan and have the legal right and capacity to enter into this Agreement ; 
 
 Have the power and lawful authority to enter into and perform this Agreement and the transaction(s) contemplated hereunder; and 
 
 The execution, delivery and performance of this Agreement and the transactions contemplated herein, do not constitute a violation of any Laws of Pakistan and/or any of the a greements/understandings by which they are bound. 
 
 The Consultant represents and warrants that the Consultant shall perform all of its obligations under the Agreement fit for intended purpose and in accordance with industry standards . 
 
 The Client represents and warrants that all information , documents and data provided by the Client to the Consultant under the Agreement is accurate, complete and true. 
 
 Intellectual Property Rights 
 
 T he Consultant shall own and control, all intellectual property rights, including without limitation the patent, trademark, copyright , trade secret rights and other intellectual property rights associated with the drawings , maps, software, techniques, inventions, works of authorship, specifications and other documents produced by the Consultant in performing the Services including all moral rights with respect to such work . 
 
 The Client may, only to the extent required for the purpose of completing the construction of the Project use and make copies of the designs, drawings, 3D Model or any other document(s) produced by the Consultant, in either paper or digital formats (“ Work Product ”). For the sake of clarity, it is stated that the Client shall not in any manner whatsoever reproduce, reuse or make copies of the Work Product for any purpose(s) other than those specified hereunder or after the completion of the construction of the Project, without the prior written appro v al of the Consultant. This clause shall survive the termination or expiry of this Agreement. 
 
 Confidentiality 
 
 The existence and the terms and conditions of this Agreement and any oral or written information including the Work Product shared and disclosed by the Consultant in connection with the preparation and/or performance of this Agreement shall be regarded as confidential information by the Client. The Client may only share the d rawings with such other consultants and contractors providing services to the Client for the construction of the Project , provided however, that such persons are made aware of the confidentiality obligations under this Agreement. This clause shall survive the termination and expiry of this Agreement. 
 
 No public announcement or press release or publicity of any kind whatsoever related to or in connection with this Agreement shall be made or attempted by or on behalf of either Party (including through their affiliates, representatives, employees, agents etc.) without the prior written consent of the other Party. 
 
 The provisions of this clause shall not be applicable in the event the disclosure of confidential information is required by law or by an order of court. 
 
 T ermination 
 
 Either Party may terminat e the Agreement with immediate effect if an event of default specified below is not cured by the defaulting party within fifteen ( 15 ) days of written notification thereof by the non-defaulting Party : 
 
 material or persistent breach of its obligations under the Agreement , including failure to pay Service Fee or any part thereof ; 
 any representation or warranty furnished being incorrect, untrue or false; 
 bankrupt cy, voluntary winding up, liquidation or insolven cy; or 
 an event of force majeure under Clause 10 continu ing for a period exceeding ninety (90) days . 
 
 The Consultant may terminate the Agreement by giving the Client thirty (30) days ’ prior written notice of termination upon the lapse of which the Agreement shall stand terminated. 
 
 Upon termination of the Agreement, the Client shall be liable to immediately pay all outstanding Service Fee or any part thereof for Services rendered and the constituent elements thereof, including all final and non-final drawings created by the Consultant while performing Services for the Client (whether accepted by the Client or not) prior to the date of termination. 
 
 Liability 
 
 The Consultant shall not in any manner be liable for the construction works, means, methods, techniques, sequences or procedures, or for safety precautions and programs in connection with the construction of the Project and it shall not be responsible for a construction contractor's failure to carry out the construction in accordance with the designs and drawings provided by the Consultant under the Agreement. 
 
 The Consultant shall not be liable for any acts or omissions of the c ontractor, subcontractors, or their agents or employees, or of any other persons undertaking the construction of the Project or otherwise employed by the Client. 
 
 The Client acknowledges that the designs provided by the Consultant are not approved by the relevant government authorities and that the Consultant does not warrant that planning or construction permission and other approvals from any relevant authorities or third parties shall be granted at all or, if granted, will be granted in accordance with any anticipated timescale. 
 
 The Client understands and acknowledges that the Consultant shall use and rely and assume the accuracy and completeness of the data, documents, information and representation s provided by the Client in order to perform the Services without independently verifying or analyzing its accuracy or completeness and the Consultant shall not be responsible for any inaccuracy or incompleteness of such information, data or documents. 
 
 The Client shall indemnify and hold the Consultant harmless from and against any and all claims, demands, actions, suits, proceedings, liabilities, losses, settlements, judgments, damages, costs and expenses etc. (including but not limited to reasonable attorney’s fees and costs), whether or not involving a third-party claim, which arise out of or relate to the breach of this Agreement by the Client or as a result of the Client’s representation being untrue, false or incomplete. 
 
 Force Majeure 
 
 Ne ither Party shall be liable to perform any of its obligations under this Agreement and such obligations shall be extended by a period reasonable under the circumstances if the performance thereof is prevented or delayed due to any cause beyond the affected Party's reasonable control which, without in any way limiting the generality of the foregoing, shall include acts of God, riots, wars, national emergencies, acts of terrorism, epidemic/pandemic, accidents, lockdowns, embargo, industrial disputes or requisition. 
 
 Governing Law &amp; Arbitration 
 
 This Agreement shall be governed by and c onstrued under laws of Pakistan. 
 
 If any dispute or difference arises between the Parties and the Parties fail to amicably settle such dispute within ten (10) days through negotiation, the Parties shall refer the matter to a sole arbitrator (the “ Arbitrator ”). Such arbitration shall be conducted under the Arbitration Act 1940, in the English language, at Lahore. Any decisions of the Arbitrator will be final and binding on the Parties. 
 
 Entire Agreement 
 
 This Agreement may only be amended, varied or modified by the mutual agreement between the Parties in writing. 
 
 This Agreement and its annexures and any other documents inferred herein shall constitute the entire agreement and understanding between the Parties with respect to the subject matter contained in this Agreement and supersedes and overrides all prior agreements, understandings and negotiations, written or oral, between the Parties. 
 
 General Clauses 
 
 Neither Party may assign, transfer or sub-contract its rights, benefits or obligations under the Agreement without the prior written consent of the Agreement. 
 
 The relationship created by this Agreement between the Parties is of independent contractors and shall not to be construed in any way as creating any partnership, principal-agent, master-servant, joint venture or other similar relationship between the Parties. 
 
 The provisions of the Agreement are severable and if one or more provisions are found to be illegal or unenforceable , in whole or part, the remaining provisions, to the extent enforceable, shall be binding and enforceable. 
 
 This Agreement may be executed in two or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, but all of which together shall constitute one and same instrument. 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF , the Parties have signed the Agreement, having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
